name: hybrid-modular-servers
description: Modular server architecture with Authentication, Media API, and Upload servers

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "cd hybrid-auth-server && npm run dev" "cd hybrid-media-api && npm run dev" "cd hybrid-upload-server && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd hybrid-auth-server && npm install && cd ../hybrid-media-api && npm install && cd ../hybrid-upload-server && npm install
scripts.apidoc:all: cd hybrid-auth-server && npm run apidoc && cd ../hybrid-media-api && npm run apidoc && cd ../hybrid-upload-server && npm run apidoc
scripts.test:all: cd hybrid-auth-server && npm test && cd ../hybrid-media-api && npm test && cd ../hybrid-upload-server && npm test
